dataset_snapshots_manifest_status_check.name: dataset_snapshots_manifest_status_check
dataset_snapshots_manifest_status_check.value: ("dataset_snapshots"."manifest_status" = 'stored' and "dataset_snapshots"."manifest" is not null) or ("dataset_snapshots"."manifest_status" <> 'stored' and "dataset_snapshots"."manifest" is null)

identifier_assignments_authoritative_uid.name: identifier_assignments_authoritative_uidx
identifier_assignments_authoritative_uid.where: "identifier_assignments"."confidence" = 'authoritative' and "identifier_assignments"."valid_to" is null and "identifier_assignments"."superseded_at" is null

ingestion_runs_failure_check.name: ingestion_runs_failure_check
ingestion_runs_failure_check.value: ("ingestion_runs"."status" = 'failed') = ("ingestion_runs"."failure_code" is not null and "ingestion_runs"."failure_message" is not null and "ingestion_runs"."failure_retryable" is not null)

ingestion_runs_content_hash_check.name: ingestion_runs_content_hash_check
ingestion_runs_content_hash_check.value: case when "ingestion_runs"."status" in ('running', 'failed') then "ingestion_runs"."content_hash" is null else "ingestion_runs"."content_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' end

observations_raw_value_status_check.name: observations_raw_value_status_check
observations_raw_value_status_check.value: ("observations"."raw_value_status" = 'stored' and "observations"."raw_value" is not null) or ("observations"."raw_value_status" <> 'stored' and "observations"."raw_value" is null)

observations_normalized_value_check.name: observations_normalized_value_check
observations_normalized_value_check.value: "observations"."normalized_value" is null or "observations"."transformation_id" is not null

observations_period_check.name: observations_period_check
observations_period_check.value: case when "observations"."period_type" = 'instant' then "observations"."period_start" is null and "observations"."period_end" is null else "observations"."period_start" is not null and "observations"."period_end" is not null and "observations"."period_start" <= "observations"."period_end" end

source_registry_rights_review_check.name: source_registry_rights_review_check
source_registry_rights_review_check.value: "source_registry"."approval_status" not in ('approved_for_spike', 'approved_personal', 'approved_public_demo') or "source_registry"."rights_reviewed_at" is not null

valuation_runs_outcome_check.name: valuation_runs_outcome_check
valuation_runs_outcome_check.value: ("valuation_runs"."status" = 'rejected') = ("valuation_runs"."result" is null and "valuation_runs"."result_hash" is null and "valuation_runs"."failure_code" is not null and "valuation_runs"."failure_message" is not null)
